109. In relation to Crown Court proceedings, there is extensive guidance on unrepresented
defendants in the Crown Court Compendium – July 2024 (April 2025 update), chapter 3 Trial
management, 3-5. This document should be consulted for additional information beyond that
set out in this chapter.

110. A similar approach to helping an unrepresented defendant is appropriate in the magistrates’
court, making apt adjustments as regards summary trial, and applying the relevant parts of
